title: Shotgun metagenomic characterization of human adenovirus F40 and a non-cpe Clostridium perfringens strain in pediatric prolonged diarrhea: a genome-resolved case study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Viral and bacterial pathogens may be concurrently detected in pediatric gastroenteritis, yet such findings are often missed by routine diagnostic methods. Shotgun metagenomic sequencing enables comprehensive detection and genomic characterization of microorganisms present in clinical specimens, including pathogens that may not be recovered by conventional testing. METHODS: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed on a single pediatric diarrheic stool sample, followed by quality filtering, de novo assembly, taxonomic classification, phylogenetic reconstruction, and integrated virulome-resistome profiling, including plasmid-associated resistance elements. RESULTS: Routine diagnostics identified adenovirus as the sole pathogen. Metagenomic analysis confirmed human adenovirus F40 (HAdV-F40), showing close phylogenetic relatedness to globally distributed HAdV-F40 reference strains and a clear distinction from HAdV-F41. In addition, metagenomics uniquely detected a Clostridium perfringens strain (SAM_A8, ST-5) that was not recovered by culture. The strain lacked the classical enterotoxin gene (cpe) but harbored a conserved histotoxic virulence profile, including cpa, pfoA, colA, hyaluronidases, and sialidases. Plasmid-associated tetracycline resistance genes (tetA(P) and tetB(P)) were also identified. CONCLUSION: This case study demonstrates the feasibility of shotgun metagenomic sequencing for comprehensive detection and genomic characterization of microorganisms present in pediatric diarrheal stool specimens, including organisms not identified by routine diagnostics. The findings are descriptive and highlight the value of metagenomics as a complementary diagnostic approach. However, no conclusions regarding pathogenic synergy, causality, or the clinical contribution of the co-detected organisms can be drawn from this single case.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对单个儿科腹泻粪便样本进行鸟枪法宏基因组测序,然后进行质量过滤、从头组装、分类学分类、系统发育重建和综合病毒组-抗性分析,包括质粒相关抗性元件。
elements_zh.methods: 鸟枪法宏基因组测序能够对临床样本中存在的微生物进行全面检测和基因组表征,包括常规测试无法发现的病原体。
elements_zh.main_results: 常规诊断确定腺病毒是唯一的病原体。宏基因组分析证实了 人腺病毒 F40 (HAdV-F4​​0),与全球分布的 HAdV-F4​​0 参考毒株显示出密切的系统发育相关性,并与 HAdV-F4​​1 有明显区别。此外,宏基因组学独特地检测到一种产气荚膜梭菌菌株(SAM_A8、ST-5),该菌株未通过培养恢复。该菌株缺乏经典的肠毒素基因 (cpe),但具有保守的组织毒性毒力谱,包括 cpa、pfoA、colA、透明质酸酶和唾液酸酶。还鉴定了质粒相关的四环素抗性基因(tetA(P)和tetB(P))。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,鸟枪法宏基因组测序可以改善小儿胃肠炎病原体的检测,有可能为更准确的诊断策略提供信息并指导有针对性的治疗干预措施。

title: A Confirmatory, Dual Center Nonhuman Primate Study on the Efficacy of Novel Oropharyngeal Spray Immunization With an Adenoviral Vector Vaccine Against RSV-Important Lessons Learned.
abstract: Background In a randomized, blinded, dual center study across two European primate research facilities, we evaluated the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a DNA prime-oropharyngeal adenoviral boost vaccination strategy against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Methods Rhesus macaques received an RSV fusion protein (F) DNA vaccine via electroporation, followed by two mucosal administrations of a recombinant adenovirus vector encoding the same antigen. Mock-vaccinated animals and a comparator group mimicking natural immunity induced by primary RSV infection were included as controls. Systemic and mucosal immune responses were monitored longitudinally. Results We detected robust cellular and humoral immune responses, but with some variability between the two centers. Nevertheless, RSV-vaccinated animals demonstrated markedly reduced viral replication in the upper and lower respiratory tract after RSV challenge infection. Unexpected RSV-specific immunity in the control group at one single study site prevented confirmation of the predefined primary endpoint. Conclusion Our results support the potential of mucosal adenoviral boosting following DNA priming to induce protective immunity against RSV, while highlighting challenges associated with multi-center preclinical vaccine studies.

title: Transgene expression kinetics and replication potential of recombinant adenovirus serotype 4 in a mouse model and its use as a herpes simplex virus vaccine.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Human adenovirus serotype 4 (Ad4) is used as a replication-competent oral vaccine that safely and effectively prevents Ad4 respiratory illness in US military personnel. Recombinant Ad4 vaccine candidates elicit mucosal and systemic immune responses against respiratory viruses in hamsters, nonhuman primates, and humans. Although evaluation of Ad4 vaccine candidates in mice would be extremely useful given the number of immunologic tools available, this has been limited by concerns about reduced viral replication in these animals. Here, we generated recombinant Ad4 vectors that express either luciferase (Ad4-Luc), green fluorescent protein (Ad4-EGFP), or herpes simplex virus type 2 (HSV-2) glycoprotein D (Ad4-gD2) to identify transgene expression kinetics, the presence of Ad4 vector replication, and HSV-2 immune responses and protection against HSV-2 infection. Local luciferase activity was observed from 7 h to 20 days after intranasal inoculation of BALB/c and humanized mice. Subsequent inoculations with Ad4-Luc showed reduced luciferase expression in BALB/c mice but robust expression in humanized mice, suggesting an immune response to the vector in wild-type mice. Ad4 DNA production, but not luciferase activity, was reduced in the lungs of BALB/c mice treated with cidofovir before inoculation with Ad4, implying that Ad4 replicated, albeit at a low level, in the lungs. Intranasal vaccination of mice with Ad4-gD2 resulted in HSV-2-neutralizing antibodies in the serum and, after HSV-2 intravaginal challenge, reduced disease scores, increased survival, and reduced shedding. Overall, the BALB/c mouse model is semi-permissive to Ad4 mucosal infection, but transgene expression is sufficient for the study of Ad4-based vaccine candidates. IMPORTANCE: Mucosal surfaces serve as the primary site of infection and shedding for many viral pathogens. Immune responses at mucosal sites provide protection, but few mucosal vaccines are licensed. The oral replication-competent adenovirus serotype 4 (Ad4) vaccine is used to prevent respiratory illness in military recruits, has an extraordinary record of safety and efficacy, and has been tested as a recombinant platform for other viruses. Further development of this vaccine platform has been partially hindered by the perceived inability to evaluate vaccine candidates in mice. Here, we characterize recombinant Ad4 transgene expression kinetics and viral replication after inoculation at various sites and show protection against herpes simplex virus type 2 (HSV-2) genital disease in mice after intranasal vaccination. We show that Ad4 can induce protective efficacy, even in a semi-permissive mouse model, suggesting this is a promising vector for HSV-2 and potentially other viral pathogens.

elements_zh.methods: 重组 Ad4 媒介 被创建来表达荧光素酶、绿色荧光蛋白或 HSV-2 糖蛋白 D。这些 媒介 通过鼻内途径接种到 BALB/c 和人源化小鼠中,随后对转基因表达、病毒复制和 免疫应答 进行评估,包括 HSV-2 中和抗体和阴道内攻击后的疾病结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 接种后 7 小时至 20 天,在 BALB/c 和人源化小鼠中观察到局部荧光素酶活性。随后接种 Ad4-Luc 显示 BALB/c 小鼠中荧光素酶表达降低,但人源化小鼠中荧光素酶表达增强。鼻内 疫苗接种 与 Ad4-gD2 产生 HSV-2 中和抗体,降低疾病评分,提高存活率,并减少阴道内攻击后的病毒脱落。

title_zh: 重组腺病毒血清型 4 在小鼠模型中的转基因表达动力学和复制潜力及其作为单纯疱疹病毒 疫苗 的用途。
source_body_en: UNLABELLED: Human adenovirus serotype 4 (Ad4) is used as a replication-competent oral vaccine that safely and effectively prevents Ad4 respiratory illness in US military personnel. Recombinant Ad4 vaccine candidates elicit mucosal and systemic immune responses against respiratory viruses in hamsters, nonhuman primates, and humans. Although evaluation of Ad4 vaccine candidates in mice would be extremely useful given the number of immunologic tools available, this has been limited by concerns about reduced viral replication in these animals. Here, we generated recombinant Ad4 vectors that express either luciferase (Ad4-Luc), green fluorescent protein (Ad4-EGFP), or herpes simplex virus type 2 (HSV-2) glycoprotein D (Ad4-gD2) to identify transgene expression kinetics, the presence of Ad4 vector replication, and HSV-2 immune responses and protection against HSV-2 infection. Local luciferase activity was observed from 7 h to 20 days after intranasal inoculation of BALB/c and humanized mice. Subsequent inoculations with Ad4-Luc showed reduced luciferase expression in BALB/c mice but robust expression in humanized mice, suggesting an immune response to the vector in wild-type mice. Ad4 DNA production, but not luciferase activity, was reduced in the lungs of BALB/c mice treated with cidofovir before inoculation with Ad4, implying that Ad4 replicated, albeit at a low level, in the lungs. Intranasal vaccination of mice with Ad4-gD2 resulted in HSV-2-neutralizing antibodies in the serum and, after HSV-2 intravaginal challenge, reduced disease scores, increased survival, and reduced shedding. IMPORTANCE: Mucosal surfaces serve as the primary site of infection and shedding for many viral pathogens. Immune responses at mucosal sites provide protection, but few mucosal vaccines are licensed. The oral replication-competent adenovirus serotype 4 (Ad4) vaccine is used to prevent respiratory illness in military recruits, has an extraordinary record of safety and efficacy, and has been tested as a recombinant platform for other viruses. Further development of this vaccine platform has been partially hindered by the perceived inability to evaluate vaccine candidates in mice. Here, we characterize recombinant Ad4 transgene expression kinetics and viral replication after inoculation at various sites and show protection against herpes simplex virus type 2 (HSV-2) genital disease in mice after intranasal vaccination. analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估重组腺病毒血清型 4 (Ad4) 在小鼠模型中的转基因表达动力学和复制潜力,并评估其作为 2 型单纯疱疹病毒 (HSV-2) 的 疫苗 平台的实用性。背景强调了粘膜表面作为许多病毒病原体感染和脱落的主要部位的重要性,以及粘膜 疫苗 的可用性有限。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: The study involved generating recombinant Ad4 媒介 expressing luciferase,green fluorescent protein,or HSV-2 glycoprotein D and testing their effects in BALB/c and humanized mice.该研究使用小鼠模型来评估 疫苗 候选药物,特别关注粘膜感染和 免疫应答。
analysis_zh.methods: 重组 Ad4 媒介 被创建来表达荧光素酶、绿色荧光蛋白或 HSV-2 糖蛋白 D。这些 媒介 通过鼻内途径接种到 BALB/c 和人源化小鼠中,随后对转基因表达、病毒复制和 免疫应答 进行评估,包括 HSV-2 中和抗体和阴道内攻击后的疾病结果。

title: Title: Combinatorial bnAb and T Cell Immunization Enhances Post-Infection Control of SHIVSF162p3 Viremia in Rhesus Macaques
abstract: An ideal HIV-1 vaccine should provide broad protection against most HIV-1 variants, control early dissemination of infected cells after virus acquisition, and avoid the risk that vaccine-induced, HIV-specific CD4+ T cells serve as targets for viral transmission. In this study, we modeled this complex host-virus interaction in rhesus macaques challenged with a single high dose of SHIVSF162p3. Specifically, we evaluated the impact of T cell immunization with a human adenovirus-5-based candidate vaccine encoding an SIV Gag-Tat fusion (AdHu5SIVGag/Tat) alongside a partially protective, limiting dose of the broadly neutralizing antibody (bnAb) PGT121. Immunization with AdHu5SIVGag/Tat elicited Gag-specific CD4+ and CD8+ T cell responses in PBMC and mucosal tissue. T cell vaccination did not affect PGT121-mediated protection against SHIVSF162p3 acquisition. However, independently of vaccination, constitutively activated CD4+α4β7+Ki-67+ T cells in rectal tissue attenuated PGT121-mediated protection. Crucially, a unique pattern of post-infection control of SHIVSF162p3 viremia emerged in AdHu5SIVGag/Tat-immunized, PGT121-treated animals, characterized by an increased eclipse phase, lower peak viremia, and a late-phase decay in steady-state viremia. These results suggest potential synergy between bnAbs and AdHu5SIVGag/Tat-induced antiviral T cell responses, with significant implications for HIV-1 vaccine development and early interventions following infection.

title: Adenovirus-Derived Virus-Like Particles Enable Rapid Encapsulation and Delivery of Functional Antigen Cargo
abstract: Abstract Adenoviral vectors have been widely validated as effective vaccine platforms for both infectious diseases and cancer due to their strong immunostimulatory properties. However, their application to personalized cancer vaccines and other time-sensitive antigens is limited by the prolonged production time required for conventional vector generation. Here, we developed an adenovirus-derived virus-like particle (Ad5VLP) platform that enables modular incorporation of antigen cargo without reconstruction of a complete antigen-encoding adenoviral genome. Ad5VLPs successfully packaged and delivered foreign mRNA, although mRNA-derived antigen expression remained insufficient to induce robust antigen-specific immunity in vivo. In contrast, direct encapsulation of protein or peptide antigens substantially improved intracellular antigen delivery and major histocompatibility complex (MHC) class I antigen presentation. Following subcutaneous prime-boost immunization in mice, antigen-loaded Ad5VLPs induced robust antigen-specific interferon-γ (IFN-γ) responses, with functional activity preferentially enriched within CD44hi CD8+ T cells and accompanied by effector-associated CD8+ T-cell differentiation. Importantly, robust cellular immune responses were also observed using an E0771 tumor neoantigen, demonstrating that the platform extends beyond the model ovalbumin (OVA) antigen. Protein-loaded Ad5VLPs also elicited antigen-specific and antivector humoral responses. Vaccination was well tolerated over the 14 day study period, with no substantial changes in body weight, clinical observations, serum markers of hepatic or renal injury and systemic inflammation, or broad splenic inflammatory transcriptional signatures. Together, these findings demonstrate that Ad5VLPs enable modular delivery of protein and peptide antigens and induce robust cellular immune responses, supporting further investigation for personalized cancer vaccination and other time-sensitive vaccine applications.

title: Local multiple-site injection of MnSOD-modified hUCMSCs alleviates combined radiation and wound injury in mice
abstract: Background Combined radiation and wound injury is a refractory complication in radiotherapy, closely associated with persistent radiation-induced oxidative stress and apoptosis. Mesenchymal stromal cell (MSC) therapy shows promise but is limited by poor cell survival in the irradiated microenvironment. This study investigated the therapeutic effects and mechanisms of local injection of human umbilical cord mesenchymal stromal cells genetically modified to overexpress manganese superoxide dismutase (MnSOD-hUCMSCs) on combined radiation and wound injury. Methods MnSOD-hUCMSCs were established using an adenoviral vector, and their conditioned medium (MnSOD-CM) was collected. A mouse model of combined radiation and wound injury was used to evaluate the wound-healing effects of local MnSOD-hUCMSCs injection. In vitro , MnSOD-CM was applied to irradiated HaCaT and HFF-1 cells. Cell viability, migration, oxidative stress, mitochondrial function, and apoptosis were assessed. Results MnSOD-hUCMSCs with improved antioxidant capacity were generated, and their conditioned medium (MnSOD-CM) recapitulated the cytoprotective effects of MnSOD-hUCMSCs in vitro . Local injection of MnSOD-hUCMSCs significantly promoted wound healing, accelerated re-epithelialization, increased collagen deposition, and reduced apoptosis in vivo . Mechanistically, MnSOD-hUCMSCs exerted effects through paracrine-mediated delivery via their conditioned medium, regulating the Bax/Bcl-2 balance and inhibiting PARP cleavage to block apoptosis. Conclusion Local injection of MnSOD-hUCMSCs effectively treats combined radiation and wound injury via their paracrine factors present in the conditioned medium. These findings suggest that paracrine factors secreted by MnSOD-hUCMSCs play a critical role in alleviating radiation-induced skin injury. The relative contribution of paracrine factors and other potential mechanisms warrants further investigation. This study offers a novel therapeutic strategy for radiation-induced skin injury.

title: Epidemiology and burden of respiratory virus-associated acute respiratory infections: a multi-source integrated population-based surveillance study in Chongqing
abstract: Abstract Background Acute respiratory infections (ARIs), particularly severe acute respiratory infections (SARIs), impose a huge disease burden globally. Respiratory viruses are key etiological agents of ARIs. Population-based data on respiratory virus disease burden in China are limited, with most studies focusing on single pathogens and lacking population-level incidence and hospitalization estimates. Methods We integrated data from national hospital-based surveillance, local health system electronic medical records (EMRs), and census records in Chongqing from October 2023 to April 2025. We also conducted a community-based healthcare utilization survey and a pilot survey. We analyzed the seasonality of six respiratory viruses and used Joinpoint software to characterize age-specific epidemiological trends. Furthermore, we identified risk factors for severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). A modified multiplier model was employed to estimate population-based incidence and hospitalization rates of ARI associated with these viruses. Results We included 16,363 respiratory infection patients (12,669 outpatients, 3,694 inpatients). Most viruses resumed pre-COVID-19 seasonal patterns. The detection rate of influenza virus (IFV) peaked in adolescents and adults; respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and human parainfluenza virus (HPIV) mainly affected infants and the elderly; human adenovirus (HAdv), human rhinovirus (HRV), and human metapneumovirus (HMPV) were most prevalent in preschoolers. RSV infection was significantly associated with a higher risk of SARI compared with other respiratory viruses (RSV vs. IFV: adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 95% confidence interval [CI]: 7.88, 5.4–11.51; RSV vs. HRV: 1.52, 1.13–2.04; RSV vs. HAdv: 3.21, 2.14–4.81; RSV vs. HMPV: 1.76, 1.24–2.50; RSV vs. HPIV: 1.63, 1.14–2.33). Incidence and hospitalization rates (per 100,000 person-years) of HRV (30,183; 2,153), HMPV (22,774; 514), RSV (22,181; 2,065), IFV (13,086; 807), HPIV (7,824; 556), and HAdv (6,991; 1,487) were highest in children under 5 years of age. Hospitalization rates rose again in those aged ≥ 60 years: HRV (170), RSV (80), IFV (70), HMPV (54), HAdv (27), HPIV (23). Conclusions Distinct age distributions and the high SARI risk of specific viruses such as RSV support targeted prevention. Integrating multi-source surveillance with sentinel surveys and standardizing the ARI case definition can yield population-level, real-world estimates of incidence and hospitalization rates for these viruses.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究整合了重庆市2023年10月至2025年4月期间全国医院监测、地方卫生系统电子病历(EMR)和人口普查记录的数据,包括16,363名呼吸道感染患者(门诊患者12,669名,住院患者3,694名)。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员采用改进的乘数模型来估计基于人群的 发病率 和与六种呼吸道病毒相关的急性呼吸道感染的住院率,并使用 Joinpoint 软件分析特定年龄的流行病学趋势。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究纳入了 16,363 名呼吸道感染患者,其中 发病率 和住院率最高的是 5 岁以下儿童。与其他呼吸道病毒相比,RSV 感染与 SARI 的较高风险显着相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定了不同的年龄分布和 RSV 等特定病毒的高 SARI 风险,支持有针对性的预防策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以告知 监测、诊断 和 治疗 呼吸道病毒,特别是儿童和老年人的呼吸道病毒,并强调将多源 监测 与哨点调查相结合的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性包括缺乏随机性以及由于数据的观察性质而导致的潜在偏差。证据强度中等。
